library.title: Controls
library.intro: Our own plainly worded controls, mapped to the frameworks you follow. 'Not yet reviewed' means no one in your organisation has checked that mapping yet.
library.professionalNote: This page shows the full detail of the Professional view. Your view setting never limits what you can open.
library.searchHint: A word, a control code such as ACC-01, or a reference such as A.8.13.
library.empty: No controls match your search. Try fewer or different words, or clear the filters.
library.resultsOf: {count} of {total, plural, one {# control} other {# controls}}
library.filtersHint: The list changes as soon as you choose. A search looks only within these filters.
library.downloadHint: Every mapping with its review status, for a spreadsheet.
library.someReviewed: {reviewed} of {total, plural, one {# mapping} other {# mappings}} reviewed
library.noMappings: Not mapped to a framework yet
library.reviewForbidden: Your role doesn't include reviewing mappings. Ask your security lead.

library.reviewFailed: We couldn't save this review just now. Please try again in a minute.
library.guidance: How to put it in place
library.mappingsHint: Each line is a requirement this control helps you meet. Mark one reviewed once you have checked that it fits your organisation.

form.title: Record a test
form.intro: Write down when you checked this control, what you found, and which evidence you used.
form.testedOnHint: Use the format 2026-11-05. It can't be in the future.
form.methodHint: Say what you did, for example 'Restored last week's backup to a spare machine.'
form.noEvidenceOptions: No evidence is linked to this control yet.

errors.testedOn: Enter the date of the test as year-month-day, for example 2026-11-05. It can't be in the future.
errors.method: Say what was checked, in plain text, up to 4,000 characters.
errors.notes: Keep your notes to 2,000 characters of plain text.
errors.evidence: One of these files can't be attached to this test. Reload the page and try again.
errors.summary: Some answers need another look. Each one has a note next to it.
errors.forbidden: Your role doesn't include recording tests for this control. Ask your security lead.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't save the test just now. Your answers are still here, so please try again in a minute.
errors.notAccepted: We couldn't accept this test. Please check it and try again.

suggest.note: Suggested from the control's description. Check the steps fit how you really work.
suggest.unavailable: The AI can't suggest steps right now. You can write them yourself.
suggest.failed: We couldn't get suggestions just now. Please try again in a minute.
